chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
For the eye of the one-eyed person, there is a complete blood-money.

key_terms.دِيَةٌ: blood-money; legally mandated financial compensation for injury
key_terms.عَيْنِ: eye; the injured organ under discussion
key_terms.كَامِلَةٌ: complete; full in amount, not partial
key_terms.ٱلْأَعْوَرِ: the one-eyed person; someone who has only one functioning eye

ai.seo_question: What is the diyah for injuring the remaining eye of a one-eyed person in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning bodily injury compensation. It states that if the remaining eye of a one-eyed person is lost, the compensation due is a complete diyah, reflecting the total loss of sight for that person.
